messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the 03:12 UTC KV OOM. Short: persistent small-object retention and slab fragmentation after shard-sync tweak. Action list below, reply with owner + ETA.

mira: Actions:
1) emergency soft-evict toggle (canary) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h
2) targeted heap captures (3 hosts) + flamegraphs -> owner: ? -> ETA: 24h
3) add `kv.frag_index` telemetry + dashboard -> owner: ? -> ETA: 8h
4) pointer-safety grep + small audit for shard-sync commit -> owner: ? -> ETA: 48h
5) rollback/runbook snippet (exact commands) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h

evan: I'll take (1). Plan: set `kv.eviction.soft_pct=85` in config and roll canary 10% us-west-2 -> 50% -> 100%, smoke tests between steps. ETA 3h.

hiro: I'll own (2). Running `heap-sample --svc=kv --secs=90` on nodes alpha/beta/gamma, will produce flamegraphs and upload to s3://dbg/kv/214567. ETA 16h.

sara: I'll pair with hiro on (4) and do the pointer grep for unsafe casts around commit `shard-sync: reduce copies` sha `f5c2b1`. ETA 30h for audit + small fixes.

mira: Metric suggestion for (3): `kv.frag_index = free_frag_bytes / used_bytes` sampled 15s per shard; alert if >0.26 for 10m. Also emit `kv.small_alloc_rate` for allocations <256B.

evan: Added `EVT:kv.soft_evict shard=%s pct=%d` log line in PR `evan/soft-evict`. Link: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/1120. Canary deploy in 25m.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket MEM-11888 "KV fragmentation follow-up" link: https://issue.redwood/MEM-11888

hiro: heap captures started on nodes, ids hs-214567-a/b/c. uploading now.

mira: Rollback criteria for soft-evict canary: p99 > baseline + 20% OR srv.oom.count > 0 OR eviction_error_rate spike >50%. Rollback command: `redwood deploy rollback --service kv-runtime --to previous`. Add runbook snippet to ticket.

sara: I'll add the metric to the agent and a provisional Grafana panel. Will require two-shard correlation before firing alerts to reduce noise. ETA 6h.

evan: Canary healthy at 10% for 20m, `kv.soft_evict` events ~2/min on few shards, no OOMs, p99 within baseline +5%. Monitoring.

mira: Thanks. Next sync in 24h to review captures + audit. If mitigations look stable we'll scope allocator RFC for next sprint. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
